pub type Raw
pub enum Profile
  Video
  ImageBatch
  pub const ALL: [Self; 2]
  pub fn as_str(self) -> &'static str
  pub fn from_wire(name: &str) -> ::std::option::Option<Self>
pub enum Mode
  Generate
  Edit
  pub const ALL: [Self; 2]
  pub fn as_str(self) -> &'static str
  pub fn from_wire(name: &str) -> ::std::option::Option<Self>
pub mod request_guarantee
  pub const LOCAL_ONLY: &str
  pub const HOSTED_ALLOWED: &str
  pub const ALL: [&str; 2]
pub const KINDS: [&str; 1]
pub const EXECUTION_GUARANTEES: [&str; 1]
pub struct ImageRequest
  model: ::std::string::String
  mode: Mode
  prompt: ::std::string::String
  size: ::std::string::String
  count: i64
  image_digest: ::std::string::String
  image_media_type: ::std::string::String
  mask_digest: ::std::string::String
  mask_media_type: ::std::string::String
  guarantees: ::std::vec::Vec<::std::string::String>
  credential: ::std::string::String
  required_extensions: ::std::vec::Vec<::std::string::String>
  extensions: ::std::collections::BTreeMap<::std::string::String, ::std::string::String>
pub struct Delivery
  digest: ::std::string::String
  media_type: ::std::string::String
  size: i64
  location: ::std::string::String
pub struct Request
  profile: Profile
  image: ImageRequest
  duration_ms: i64
pub struct JobResult
  profile: Profile
  deliveries: ::std::vec::Vec<Delivery>
  host: ::std::string::String
  model: ::std::string::String
pub struct Document
  request: ::std::option::Option<Request>
  result: ::std::option::Option<JobResult>
pub fn encode(v: &Document) -> ::std::vec::Vec<u8>
pub struct Refusal
  word: &'static str
  offset: usize
pub fn decode(data: &[u8]) -> ::std::result::Result<Document, Refusal>
pub trait JsonRecord: ::std::marker::Sized
  fn to_json(&self) -> ::std::vec::Vec<u8>
  fn from_json(data: &[u8]) -> ::std::result::Result<Self, Refusal>
